description: Defines a template class 'interval' representing numeric intervals with various utility methods, including overlap, containment, and manipulation functions, along with formatting support.

classes.name: ocudu::interval
classes.description: Template class representing a numeric interval with customizable bounds, closed or open ends, and various interval operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start point of the interval.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Returns the stop point of the interval.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Calculates the length of the interval.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the start and stop points of the interval.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the interval length by a specified amount.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the interval to a new length.

methods.name: displace_by
methods.description: Displaces the interval by an offset.

methods.name: displace_to
methods.description: Moves the start of the interval to a specified point.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this interval overlaps with another.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point or another interval is contained within this interval.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Calculates the intersection with another interval.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a point to within the interval bounds.

methods.name: convert_to
methods.description: Converts the interval to another interval type with the same bounds.
